tips: Press Esc twice (or type /rewind) to undo Claude's last steps
/plan <task> makes Claude plan before it edits anything
/clear starts fresh when you switch tasks: faster and cheaper
/btw asks a side question without derailing the current task
/rename names this session; claude --continue picks up where you left off
/usage shows how much of your limit you've used
/ingot:start shows what Ingot can do in this folder
/ingot:settings changes the reply style and coaching level
claude --safe-mode runs without add-ons, to compare
